## MHDSR

**What.** MHDSR (Methods in Health Data Science with R) is a live, cohort-based training pathway in applied biostatistics, machine learning, survival analysis, and evidence synthesis, taught in R with reproducible Quarto workflows. It comprises four courses, **BIOSTATR**, **ML4HOR**, **SURV4CR**, and **METAR**, that can be taken independently or followed as a complete pathway.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pathway
#| fig-cap: "The MHDSR pathway"
#| out-width: "100%"

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph mhdsr_pathway {

  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = LR, bgcolor = transparent, nodesep = 0.5, ranksep = 0.8]
  node [shape = box, style = 'filled,rounded', fontname = 'Helvetica', fontsize = 13,
        color = '#C2410C', fillcolor = '#FFEDD5', fontcolor = '#111827', penwidth = 1.4]
  edge [color = '#0284C7', penwidth = 1.2, arrowsize = 0.8]

  BIOSTATR [label = 'BIOSTATR\\nFoundations']
  ML4HOR   [label = 'ML4HOR\\nPrediction']
  SURV4CR  [label = 'SURV4CR\\nTime-to-event']
  METAR    [label = 'METAR\\nEvidence synthesis']

  {rank = same; BIOSTATR; ML4HOR; SURV4CR; METAR}

  BIOSTATR -> ML4HOR -> SURV4CR -> METAR
}
")
```

Each course can be taken independently (no prerequisite is mandatory), but the order above is recommended for participants building comprehensive mastery.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
**{{< fa bullseye >}} Why**

Health researchers are often taught statistics and R as separate subjects, disconnected from the reproducible workflows expected in publication and clinical practice. MHDSR closes that gap: every course pairs the underlying methodology with a hands-on R implementation and ends with a reproducible Quarto report.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
**{{< fa users >}} Who it's for**

Clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and analysts who want a rigorous, hands-on introduction to modern health data analysis in R. No advanced statistics background is required for **BIOSTATR**; the other three courses build on it but can be taken independently.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
**{{< fa clipboard-list >}} What you get**

Live sessions, slides, notebooks, datasets, and exercises for every session, with direct feedback in a small cohort, ending in a short reproducible Quarto mini-project.
:::

:::
<!-- end grid -->
